Vacuums(x) ::: x is a vacuum.
Vampires(x) ::: x is a vampire.
Space(x) ::: x is space.

Premises:
Plungers suck.
Vacuums suck.
Vampires suck.
Space is a vacuum.

Conclusion:
Sucks(space) ::: Space sucks.
